{{Quote|Thank you, Jedi Saar, for your extravagant efforts on this cause. We certainly recommend that everyone acquire and familiarize themselves with your report.|[[Kenth Hamner]] to Sothais Saar|<ref name="backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
'''''An Inquiry on Surviving Slavery Practices in the Aftermath of the Second Galactic Civil War''''' was a report filed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sothais Saar]] sometime in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], regarding the subject of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] in regions not controlled by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. After briefing the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|High Council]] with his report, Saar announced that he would have an annotated and cross-indexed version available in three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]].<ref name="backlash" />
